versions.content: Reporting control of dtc failed to IdsM In case a diagnostic service ControlDTCSetting is received, which re- sults in a negative response, the Dcm shall report a security event SEV_UDS_CONTROL_DTC_SETTING_FAILED to IdsM (see [11] and table [SWS_Dcm_01737]) with the context data given in [SWS_Dcm_01737].
